scenarios.title: No bake node state: passthrough of the input geometry
notes: Cube base vertices are at x=+-1; passthrough means min_x=-1+Shift, max_x=1+Shift.
Shift is keyed 0.5*f on frames 1..5 with LINEAR interpolation; frames 0 and 6 use constant extrapolation.

scenarios.title: ANIMATION bake, PACKED, input change and delete
notes: Input change: mesh replaced with a 42-vertex icosphere, Shift keys removed, Shift=100.
Delete: geometry_node_bake_delete_single, then the same frames are sampled.

scenarios.title: STILL bake at frame 3 held across frame changes
notes: Default bake_mode on a freshly created bake is STILL; the bake was made while the scene was on frame 3.
Frame changes are sampled before and after changing scene.frame_end from 5 to 20.

scenarios.title: PACKED bake saved to out/packed.blend and reopened in a fresh process
notes: Reopened in a fresh Blender child process; no bake data was re-created.

scenarios.title: DISK bake into //oracle_disk_bake: layout, reopen, and directory deletion
notes: Relative directory resolved against the saved .blend location (work/s5/).
Before save/reopen the animation was removed and Shift set to 100, distinguishing baked output from live input.

scenarios.title: DISK bake with empty bake_directory: default location and value
notes: Blend saved as s6_default.blend so the blend name is 's6_default'.

scenarios.title: DISK bake, bake_directory changed to an empty dir in-session and after reopen
notes: //empty_dir was created empty before the change; //s7_disk holds the bake files.
After the directory change, animation was removed and Shift set to 100 to distinguish cache output from live evaluation.

scenarios.title: ANIMATION bake with custom simulation frame range 2..4
notes: Scene range stays 1..5; the bake uses its own custom range 2..4.

scenarios.title: Bake node with a FLOAT item feeding Transform after the bake
notes: Geometry item and FLOAT item (named Shift) are both baked; Transform consumes the baked float.
Shift input is set to 100 after bake; baked float should keep 0.5*f at baked frames.

scenarios.title: ANIMATION bake whose geometry topology changes between baked frames
notes: Shift > 1.25 selects a 42-vertex IcoSphere; otherwise an 8-vertex Cube. Frame 2 (Shift 1.0) is Cube, frame 3 (Shift 1.5) is IcoSphere.

scenarios.title: DISK bake with one missing frame after input change and reopen
notes: The ANIMATION bake is saved to disk, then the live mesh is replaced with a 42-vertex IcoSphere and Shift=100.
The frame-3 metadata and blob files are deleted before reopening the .blend in a fresh Blender process.

scenarios.title: Bake a POINT-domain FLOAT field derived from Position
notes: The Bake node captures Geometry and a POINT-domain FLOAT field (Position.x + Shift).
Changing Shift from 0.5 to 100 leaves the cached field and geometry intact; delete resumes live field evaluation.

scenarios.title: Bake-node DISK target, custom path, and frame range
notes: The Bake node overrides modifier PACKED with DISK and uses its //node_cache path, not modifier //modifier_cache.
The custom 2..4 frame range clamps at its endpoints and cached values survive input changes and reopen.

scenarios.title: Bake attribute-field output from a POINT-domain FLOAT item
notes: The Bake item is marked as an attribute and is stored on the baked geometry.
The named attribute is sampled through Store Named Attribute downstream before and after delete.

scenarios.title: Pack a disk Bake-node cache, reopen it, then unpack to its original path
notes: Pack keeps the existing disk files and sets the node target to PACKED.
The packed state survives a fresh process and USE_ORIGINAL returns it to the original disk cache.

scenarios.title: Unpack a packed Bake-node cache to the current blend directory
notes: WRITE_LOCAL removes old metadata/blob cache directories, writes packed data to the current blend directory, and sets the node's custom path.
The unpacked disk cache survives save/reopen after the animated input is removed.
